digest.component_or_area: plan-review T10 overlay rubric and evaluation spec
propositions: T10 rubric must add a scope clause partitioning durable infrastructure (persistent IaC/config) from transient, throwaway de-risk experiments

T10 rubric must immediately follow the scope clause with a safety qualifier preserving four MAJOR safety classes: destructive apply, wildcard-admin access, plaintext-secret, and unspecified-auth transient services
T10 rubric must remain independent and not reference T15 or delegate scope to other overlays
A packaged eval spec with ten balanced dataset cases (five pass, five finding) must prove transient exclusion and MAJOR safety preservation through live criterion evaluation
Offline text-contract tests must lock the exact scope clause, exact co-located safety qualifier, rubric independence, and downstream rendering in explain and guide regeneration
